name: it-helpdesk
description: An IT helpdesk application where users can file tickets manually or by chatting with an AI assistant that extracts structured ticket details automatically. Built as a full-stack TypeScript monorepo to explore tool-calling AI integration, Redis-backed rate limiting, and role-based access control end to end.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run start:dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend --workspace=backend
